name: Ayurveda Hotel Sonnhof
beschreibung: The Ayurveda Hotel Sonnhof is situated in tranquil Thiersee, a valley town in Tyrol's Kaisergebirge mountain range. The property combines Ayurvedic healing arts with alpine hospitality and is aimed at guests seeking deep relaxation and holistic recovery. The rooms are classically furnished, and the spa area offers a wide range of Ayurveda treatments. Offerings include individually tailored therapy programs, yoga, and balanced cuisine. The hotel is ideal for anyone wishing to spend a structured health and wellness retreat surrounded by mountain nature.
